OFFICIAL RULES TEXT:
Dear Biconomy Users,
The IRYS Trading Competition is here!
## Trade IRYS/USDT on Biconomy and compete for a share of the 500,000 IRYS prize pool!
## 📅Activity time
## November 25 — December 02, 2026 (UTC)
## 📝 How to Participate
1. Create or log in to your Biconomy account
2. Register for the campaign: Join Now
3. Trade IRYS_USDT during the event period
## 🏁 Competition Rules
## Ranking Calculation
- Ranking is based on total eligible IRYS/USDT trading volume (Buy + Sell) during the campaign.
- Only filled orders count toward trading volume. Cancelled or unfilled orders are excluded.
- Tie-breaker: If two or more users have the same eligible trading volume, the user who reaches that volume first will rank higher.
## Eligibility
- Minimum cumulative IRYS/USDT trading volume: 500 USDT
- Complete at least 10 filled IRYS/USDT trades during the campaign.
## 🎁 Prize Distribution (500,000 IRYS):
RANKING | PRIZE | Minimum Trading Volume
🥇 1st Place | 80,000 IRYS | 150,000 USDT
🥈 2nd Place | 55,000 IRYS | 100,000 USDT
🥉 3rd Place | 25,000 IRYS | 50,000 USDT
4th-10th Place | Share 140,000 IRYS by Trading Volume | 35,000 USDT
11th – 30th Place | Share 200,000 IRYS by Trading Volume | 20,000 USDT
Qualified users will share 500,000 IRYS based on their trading volume rankings.
Your Reward = (Your Eligible Trading Volume ÷ Total Eligible Trading Volume of All Qualified Users in the Same Ranking Group) × Corresponding Prize Pool
## Notes
1.You must complete the campaign sign-up on this page to be eligible to participate.
2. Users will be ranked based on their total eligible IRYS/USDT trading volume (Buy + Sell) during the campaign period on Biconomy.
3. All rewards will be distributed within 7 business days after the campaign ends.
4. Biconomy reserves the right to disqualify accounts involved in wash trading, self-trading, market manipulation, multi-account abuse, or other fraudulent activities. Such trades will not count toward campaign rankings or rewards.
5. Biconomy reserves the right to the final interpretation of this campaign.
